title: Darkroom — Dither & Halftone Lab
description: Seventeen dithering and halftone screens, ten palettes and a full tone stage, developing any image you drop in.
concept: A darkroom for the browser. Drop in a photo — or start from one of four procedural test plates — and push it through a real image pipeline: exposure, contrast, gamma, saturation, blur and unsharp mask, then a screen of your choosing. Six error-diffusion kernels, six ordered masks and three rotated halftone screens all render live, against paper-and-ink duotones, handheld greens, riso inks or a median-cut palette pulled from the image itself. A wipe divider compares the negative against the print, and the result exports as a PNG at up to 4×.
features: 17 screens — Floyd–Steinberg, Atkinson, Jarvis, Stucki, Burkes, Sierra, Bayer 2/4/8, clustered dot, R2 and white noise, plus rotated dot, line and cross-hatch halftones
Full tone stage — exposure, contrast, gamma, saturation, box blur, unsharp mask and negative inversion, all live
10 palettes including a median-cut quantiser that derives 2–16 inks from the image, plus custom ink and paper colours
Drop or open your own image; four procedural plates (sphere, test wedge, dunes, bloom) ship inside the file
8 one-tap looks — Newsprint, Riso duo, Handheld, Phosphor, Blueprint, Zine, Etching, Silver
Before/after wipe divider, wheel zoom, drag pan and 1:1 / 2× / 4× inspection
PNG export at 1×, 2× and 4× with verified non-empty output
Named recipes saved to localStorage, session state restored on return, and a share link that packs every setting into the URL

interaction.mouse: Drag to pan the print, wheel to zoom, drag the amber handle to move the before/after wipe
interaction.click: Pick a look, a plate, a screen or a palette; tap PNG to download; tap Link to copy the recipe
interaction.touch: Tap ⚙ Controls for the bottom sheet, drag to pan, double-tap to refit
interaction.keyboard: 1–9 switch screen · E export · O open image · S compare · I invert · F fit · R reset
